note: Canonical CCF control families. Every safeguard's risk_domain must be one of these ids, and every family belongs to exactly one category.

categories.label: Governance and risk
categories.description: Direction and oversight of the security program: policies, roles, obligations, risk assessment and treatment, and independent assessment.

categories.label: Identity and access
categories.description: Who can authenticate and what they can reach, across people, services, and AI agents.

categories.label: Data protection and privacy
categories.description: Protecting data through its life cycle and honoring the rights and expectations of the people it describes.

categories.label: Secure engineering
categories.description: Building and changing systems securely: development life cycle, architecture, and authorized change.

categories.label: Infrastructure security
categories.description: Keeping the running estate hardened: configuration baselines, network boundaries, and vulnerability remediation.

categories.label: Detection and response
categories.description: Seeing adverse activity through monitoring and audit logs, and handling incidents when they happen.

categories.label: Resilience and integrity
categories.description: Keeping systems available, supported, and processing correctly: recovery, maintenance, and processing integrity.

categories.label: Third-party and supply chain
categories.description: Risk that arrives through suppliers, service providers, and acquired components, including models and datasets.

categories.label: People and physical
categories.description: Personnel screening, training, and awareness, and protection of facilities and equipment.

categories.label: AI governance
categories.description: Governing AI systems through their life cycle: inventory, evaluation, oversight, transparency, and impact.

families.label: Identity and access
families.description: Who can authenticate and what they can reach: accounts, MFA, access reviews, logon limits, and separation of duties.

families.label: Data protection
families.description: Knowing what data exists and protecting it at rest and in transit through its retention and disposal.

families.label: Detection
families.description: Finding potentially adverse activity: monitoring, alerting, and malicious-code scanning.

families.label: Audit logging
families.description: Generating, retaining, and reviewing audit records.

families.label: Change management
families.description: Authorized, tested, and recorded changes to systems.

families.label: Configuration management
families.description: Hardened baselines, least functionality, and authorized software execution.

families.label: Secure development
families.description: Security built into the software development life cycle.

families.label: Secure architecture
families.description: Security engineering principles, isolation, and separating user from management functions.

families.label: Vulnerability management
families.description: Identifying, prioritizing, and remediating vulnerabilities.

families.label: Third-party risk
families.description: Supplier and service-provider due diligence and ongoing monitoring.

families.label: Risk management
families.description: Assessing, prioritizing, responding to, and independently evaluating risk.

families.label: Availability and recovery
families.description: Backups, redundancy, and continuity of operations.

families.label: Incident response
families.description: Handling and communicating security and privacy incidents.

families.label: Governance
families.description: Policies, roles, and the control environment that direct the program.

families.label: People security
families.description: Awareness training and personnel actions such as termination and transfer.

families.label: Physical security
families.description: Physical access, environmental protection, and alternate work sites.

families.label: Network security
families.description: Protecting networks and network services from unauthorized access.

families.label: System maintenance
families.description: Controlled maintenance and maintenance tooling.

families.label: Processing integrity
families.description: Complete, accurate, timely, and authorized processing.

families.label: Privacy
families.description: Privacy notices and data subject rights.

families.label: AI governance
families.description: AI system inventory, context, categorization, monitoring, and post-deployment response.
